candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from downstream latency: gateway POST /v1/orders to order times out (~2s ReadTimeout, transport error), and order's own call to payment /v1/authorizations also ReadTimeouts. Inventory/redis reservation succeeds quickly, so the delay originates in the order->payment path, propagating 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-service telemetry; cannot confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable. Order->payment latency not directly measured.

report.explanation: Traces and logs show consistent ~2s ReadTimeouts on gateway->order and order->payment, with inventory/redis healthy, producing 502s at /v1/checkout. Downstream latency in the order->payment path is the best-supported bounded cause; payment-side evidence is still needed to localize it.
missing_evidence: Payment service traces/metrics to confirm payment-side latency vs. unreachability
Order service server-side latency and error logs for /v1/orders
Network/connection error detail (timeout vs. connection refused) for order->payment
